question: Should this signed marketplace feed slice be required to enforce sequence/freshness rollback protection and preserve signed profile verification across URL overrides before merge?
rationale: The PR creates a new marketplace feed trust boundary; automation can identify the bypasses, but maintainers must either require repair or explicitly accept staged security/compatibility risk.

options.title: Require trust repairs before merge
options.body: Block merge until signed refresh rejects stale sequence/freshness updates and feedUrl plus feedProfile cannot drop signed verification.

options.title: Accept temporary trust gap
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge this staged slice with a documented follow-up, carrying rollback and URL-override bypass risk until that follow-up lands.

options.title: Pause behind stack predecessors
options.body: Keep this PR open behind the envelope verifier and signed config predecessor PRs until those contracts are settled on the final base.

recommendation.title: Require trust repairs before merge
recommendation.body: Block merge until signed refresh rejects stale sequence/freshness updates and feedUrl plus feedProfile cannot drop signed verification.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned on the PR, authored the current substantive review comments, and pushed the latest branch repair commit.
